title: Parts of Speech
summary: The eight parts of speech: nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions and interjections, with their types, functions and degrees of comparison.

rows: Names a person, place, thing or idea
he, she, it, they, mine, who, myself
Shows an action or a state of being
Describes a verb, adjective or another adverb (how, when, where, how often, to what extent)
Shows the relationship of a noun to another word (position, time, direction)
and, but, or, because, although, when
Specific names; always start with a capital letter
a **flock** of sheep, a **team** of players, a **swarm** of bees, a **pride** of lions
Ideas, feelings and qualities that cannot be touched
Things you can see, touch, hear, smell or taste

items: **Personal**: I, you, he, she, it, we, they (subject); me, him, her, us, them (object).
**Possessive**: mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.
**Relative**: who, whom, whose, which, that (introduce relative clauses).

notes.label: Common mistake
notes.text: Never use **more** with an **-er** word: say 'taller', not 'more taller'. Use **fewer** with things you can count (fewer learners) and **less** with things you cannot count (less water).

notes.title: Comparing correctly
notes.problem: Give the comparative and superlative of tall, beautiful and good.
steps: One-syllable words add -er and -est: taller, tallest.
Longer words use more and most: more beautiful, most beautiful.

notes.title: Labelling a sentence
notes.problem: Identify the part of speech of each word: 'Wow, the young players ran quickly onto the field and they cheered.'
steps: Wow: interjection; the: article (a type of adjective/determiner); young: adjective; players: noun
ran: verb; quickly: adverb; onto: preposition; the: article; field: noun
and: conjunction; they: pronoun; cheered: verb
notes.answer: A word's part of speech depends on how it is used in the sentence.

notes.text: The same word can be different parts of speech. *She will **run** the race* (verb). *She went for a **run*** (noun).
